svg.text: dense dark spruce on a mossy floor, snow lying in the hollows, narrow shadows; the boreal forest between the forest and the tundra
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 21.3 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 22.2 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a black band through the spruce: trunks charred on one side, needles
singed rust-brown, the snow in the hollows melted to a dark line
a bowl of dark mossy loam with a ring of felled spruce lying outward like
spokes and snow thrown over them
a standing burn: black bare spruce with a few rust needles, grey ash on
the snow, the moss floor black

C. Destruction in taiga: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Snow and needles: a pale powder column, white and blue crystals, dark needle shards and bark chunks arcing out, a low dark dirt skirt under it.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
